name: Don't Be Tachy Glitter Heart Badge Holder
seoTitle: Don't Be Tachy Badge Holder for Cardiac Nurses
metaDescription: A black glitter heart badge holder with the Don't Be Tachy pun, made for cardiac nurses and students. A fun way to dress up an ID badge on every shift.
summary: A glittery heart badge holder with a cardiac pun only healthcare folks fully appreciate. A fun pick for cardiac, telemetry, and cardiology nurses.
whyItWorks: Badges are the most visible accessory a nurse wears. They get flipped, scanned, and tapped dozens of times a shift, and patients notice them during every conversation. That makes badge holders one of the best places for a little personality, and a heart rhythm pun like Don't Be Tachy is tailor made for anyone who watches monitors all day on a cardiac or telemetry unit.

The black glitter keeps it fun without looking childish, and the metal clip named in the title suggests it is meant to attach securely to scrubs or a lanyard. It is a thoughtful gift for a cardiology student who just survived their first EKG class or a seasoned cardiac nurse who will appreciate the joke on a hard day. Because it is budget friendly, it is easy to add to a Nurses Week bag or a holiday card. Check the listing to see how the badge attaches and whether a reel is included.
goodToKnow: Check the listing to see if it includes a retractable reel or just the holder and clip.
Confirm it will hold the recipient's badge size, since hospital IDs vary.
The pun lands best with cardiac, telemetry, and ICU staff.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a cardiology student?
faq.a: Yes, students who are learning heart rhythms will get the joke right away. It is a fun encouragement gift during school or at graduation.

faq.q: Will the hospital allow a decorative badge holder?
faq.a: Most units are fine with fun badge accessories as long as the ID stays visible. It is worth asking if she works somewhere with a strict dress code.
